name: CAP-CPT reproduction (arXiv 2510.11588) under identical conditions
analysis_prompt: official Utils/Policy_Analysis/Final_Prompting.md of the CAP-CPT release (not redistributed; pass --prompt-file)
generator: Qwen3-32B, vLLM, non-thinking; temperature 0.7 / top_p 0.8 / top_k 20 (analysis greedy)

data_per_seed.trajectory: the SFT rows rendered as their exact training text

inference_anchor: Based on the policy document #Pxxxxx you previously learnt about, answer the user query.

arms.capcpt_conf: CPT full -> SFT prec_anchor (P_anchor + prec's 128 conflict rows verbatim)

eval.frozen: probe set (none / orig / override_official / override_held / substitute)
eval.pid: none items with the anchor sentence

predictions.H1: prec - best(capcpt, capcpt_nosim) >= 10pp on override_held and substitute, CI lower bound > 0, >= 2/3 seeds positive
predictions.H2: capcpt_conf - capcpt >= 10pp on both, same CI/seed rule, and capcpt_conf none >= capcpt none - 5pp
